packet.explanation: Reading and tracing code means going through a program line by line, like a detective, to see exactly how each part works and how variables change step by step. It helps you understand what the code is doing without running it.
packet.strategy: To trace code by hand, start by writing down all variable names and their initial values. Then go through each line of the code one at a time, in order, and update the variables as the code would. After each line, note any changes in variable values or program flow (like entering a loop or condition). Keep track of the current line and any output the code would produce. This helps understand how the program behaves step by step.
